name: plx
description: Parallax (plx) — multi-model coding-agent orchestration as a toolbox: the orchestrator drives Codex, Grok, and Claude headless through one wrapper (plx-engine) with lane rubrics injected at runtime — no subagents. The /plx:* commands run the dev, goal-spec, or review pipeline or hand a task to a single engine. dev = plan → red-team → build (one writer engine) → parallel review lanes → fix → gate, then docs + a local commit. Review lanes are read-only; every engine choice is a default, not a limit.
